capabilities: Render infographic code blocks from JSON specs or an Infographic DSL
Zoom, pan, and review diagrams in a fullscreen viewer
Copy or export diagrams as PNG and SVG images
Resize and center blocks via drag handles and fence parameters
Apply built-in themes and rough/pattern/gradient stylize effects
extras: README notes the plugin may not yet appear in the community store and gives BRAT and manual-install instructions; it requires Obsidian 1.13+ and is MIT licensed with Apache-2.0 portions inherited from obsidian-infographic.
intentEvidence: This plugin incorporates code ported and modified from shuuul/obsidian-infographic (v0.2.0, Apache-2.0)
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render data-rich infographic diagrams inside notes.

relations.evidence: code ported and modified from shuuul/obsidian-infographic (v0.2.0, Apache-2.0)

summary: Code-block renderer that draws infographic diagrams from JSON specs or an Infographic DSL using @antv/infographic.
